reply_text:
Installed **GBrain v0.60.734.0** from the requested GitHub release and connected it to Codex.

Verified health checks, memory persistence, and exact keyword retrieval. Restart Codex to load the new MCP tools.

Current settings: keyless keyword search (`conservative`), explicit remembering only, free upkeep on, local conversation archive on. Disable the archive with `gbrain transcripts archive off`.

GBrain’s estimated downstream input costs at 10K queries/month:

| Mode | Luna | Terra | Sol |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Conservative | $8 | $100 | $200 |
| Balanced | $20 | $250 | $500 |
| Tokenmax | $40 | $500 | $1,000 |

These are payload estimates, separate from provider charges. Change modes with `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`.
